lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Texas Move Over / Slow Down Act Statutes
prompt: Why was the Move Over / Slow Down Act enacted into Texas statutory law?

options.text: To prevent fatal collisions where passing vehicles strike first responders on shoulders
To generate municipal parking fine revenue for rural county sheriff offices
To reduce roadway pavement wear caused by heavy emergency vehicle tire chains
To mandate that all Texas drivers complete annual roadside first aid exams
